## OurGraduatesWorkForTheWorld'sTopCompany

## Frequently Asked Question

## Do I need any prior coding or tech experience to join a bootcamp?

No, our bootcamps are designed for beginners! We teach you everything from the ground up, ensuring you develop the skills you need to succeed, even if you're new to tech.

## How do the live classes work?

We offer live classes twice a week—once in the morning and once in the evening, so you can choose the time that suits you. If you miss a session, don’t worry—recordings are available for you to catch up at your convenience.

## What kind of job support does Zaio offer?

We offer guaranteed job placement assistance. This includes resume building, interview coaching, mock interviews, and direct connections to hiring partners to help you secure your first tech job.

## How flexible are the payment options?

We offer multiple payment options to fit your budget. You can pay upfront, in installments, or finance your education through partners like Manati and Capitec. This allows you to focus on learning while paying over time.

## What happens if I fall behind in the course?

Don’t worry! Our 24/7 tutor support is here to help. You can reach out any time for assistance, and we’ll work with you to ensure you stay on track. Plus, you can catch up by watching recorded class sessions.

## What career outcomes can I expect after completing the bootcamp?

Zaio graduates have gone on to secure roles as web developers, data scientists, and junior software engineers. Our job placement support helps you land interviews, and our alumni network provides additional support as you navigate your job search.

## Can I study while working full-time?

Yes! Our flexible learning options, including live classes held at different times and recorded sessions, allow you to study while balancing a full-time job or other commitments.

## Zaio: Tech Career Advancement

**[June/July 2025 applications now open – Apply Now!](https://applications.zaio.io/)**

### Key Offerings

*   **Bootcamps**
    *   [Full Stack Web Development](https://www.zaio.io/fullstack-bootcamp)
        *   Learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js, and more.
        *   Build dynamic websites and applications.
        *   NQF Level 5 certification
    *   [Data Science](https://www.zaio.io/datascience-bootcamp)
        *   Master Python, machine learning, data analysis, and SQL.
        *   Work on real-world data science projects.
        *   Microsoft certification
    *   [Cybersecurity](https://www.zaio.io/cybersecurity-bootcamp)
        *   Master Cybersecurity fundamentals and best practices.
        *   CompTIA A+ Security certification
*   **Micro Bootcamps**
    *   [Web Development Fundamentals](https://www.zaio.io/web-development-fundamentals)
    *   [Front End coding with React.js](https://www.zaio.io/frontend-coding-with-react)
    *   [Back End coding with Node.js](https://www.zaio.io/backend-coding-with-node)
    *   [Fundamentals of Python](https://www.zaio.io/fundamentals-of-python)
    *   [AI Essentials for Office Professionals](https://www.zaio.io/ai-essentials-for-office-professionals)

### Community Resources

*   [Community](https://www.zaio.io/community)
    *   [❤️ Hall of fame](https://www.zaio.io/hall-of-fame-p)
    *   [Join Discord](https://discord.gg/4TcfWX5vE5)
    *   [Blog](https://blog.zaio.io/)

### Additional Information

*   [For Company](https://www.zaio.io/company)
*   [Login](https://www.zaio.io/app/login)

### Career Support & Benefits

*   **Job Placement Assistance:** Guaranteed job placement support, including resume building, interview prep, and connections to hiring partners.
*   **Flexible Payment Plans:** Options to pay upfront, in installments, or through financing partners (Manati and Capitec).
*   **24/7 Support:** Access to a strong community, AI tutor, and a dedicated team of expert tutors.
*   **Flexible Learning Options:** Live classes twice a week with morning and evening sessions, and recorded classes for on-demand learning.

### Job Market Insights

*   The demand for web developers is projected to grow 22% per year.
*   Median salary for frontend web developers in South Africa: ZAR 466,000 (as per [talent.com](https://za.talent.com/salary?job=web+developer) report, March 2024).

### Frequently Asked Questions

*   **Do I need any prior coding or tech experience to join a bootcamp?**
    No, bootcamps are designed for beginners.
*   **How do the live classes work?**
    Live classes are held twice a week, with morning and evening options. Recordings are available.
*   **What kind of job support does Zaio offer?**
    Guaranteed job placement assistance, including resume building, interview coaching, and connections to hiring partners.
*   **How flexible are the payment options?**
    Multiple payment options are available: upfront, installments, or financing through partners.
*   **What happens if I fall behind in the course?**
    24/7 tutor support is available, and recorded class sessions can be used to catch up.
*   **What career outcomes can I expect after completing the bootcamp?**
    Graduates have secured roles as web developers, data scientists, and junior software engineers.
*   **Can I study while working full-time?**
    Yes, flexible learning options accommodate various schedules.
